about.purpose: Mandate knowledge base for routing grievances among the CPGRAMS Central Ministries/Departments in scope (Phase 7).
about.scope_rule: The 35 entities with the highest mean monthly receipts in the T6 monthly panel (#29-#45, about 91% of panel receipts), plus the Staff Selection Commission (rank 36) and the Department of Urban Development (successor of MoHUA in CPGRAMS from Sep 2026).
about.official_text: The official mandate of each entry is the verbatim text of the Allocation of Business Rules items listed in aob_refs (source aob_rules in sources.csv). The build step copies that text; it is never paraphrased here.
about.project_authored_fields: grievance_responsibilities (a plain-language paraphrase that cites AoB items), common_grievance_categories, keywords, overlaps and notes are written by this project from the AoB items and general knowledge. They are not an official CPGRAMS category list and a keyword match never proves jurisdiction.
